name: mf-tgca-scope-and-compliance
description: French Saint-Martin general turnover tax (taxe generale sur le chiffre d'affaires, TGCA) for 2026 under the collectivity's tax code consolidated to 5 June 2026. Covers who is liable, territorial rules for goods and services, the article 251 exclusions (imports, local producers, goods bought as stock), the export exemption that excludes the Dutch side, the 4% ordinary rate and the 2% affordable-housing works rate, the base and rounding, cash basis and the written debit election, no offset of TGCA paid, monthly returns (quarterly if annual tax is under 2,000 euros) by the 15th, registration within 15 days, foreign-supplier checks, and the 2026 email-and-transfer channel. Applies to French Saint-Martin, not Sint Maarten. Trigger phrases include TGCA Saint-Martin, taxe generale sur le chiffre d'affaires, Saint-Martin sales tax 4%, declaration TGCA.
